blockers_addressed.defect: Forecasts flattened candidate and background offsets, so joint commands survived imagined member departure or ego contact loss despite live cancellation.
blockers_addressed.resolution: Scoring preserves ego_id, members and offset_profile for every commitment. The live controller and WM decoder share the observable in_contact predicate. Each imagined action has independent cancellation state, checked at the live whole-second cadence and reset only at a new future's tick zero. A lost member, lost CAV membership, or out-of-range partner permanently releases the entire commitment in that branch; later recontact cannot revive it. Background commitments retain independent lifetimes in both scoring arms. Partially observed backgrounds fail closed without exposing unseen member metadata. Base-policy continuation and the full 600-second rollout remain active after cancellation.
